description:
ARES Health AI is a remote, Spanish-speaking team developing a prototype to help astronauts monitor health indicators and identify potential risks during long-duration missions.

I'm a student from Mexico with experience in personal AI projects and Python. We welcome motivated teammates in software development, data analysis, AI/ML, UX/UI, and biomedical research.

All experience levels are welcome. Our goal is to build a practical, evidence-informed solution through collaboration.
